title: UFO flying figure eights shoots into mountain without explosion

tellings.quote: And so they stand there and they're watching this, and then it deviates dramatically, and it shoots off at low altitude right into the mountain itself. But there's no explosion. It's just gone.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah known for reports of strange events, witnesses are said to have watched an object fly figure eights. Then it suddenly broke off and shot at low altitude straight into the mountain, with no explosion: "It's just gone." Robert Bigelow, a guest on an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, passes this on as what the witnesses told him, as a case of an object behaving like no known aircraft.
